rationale: The agent actually changes both router packages to 7.0.2 and successfully regenerates installation state, but performs no source, module-resolution, or runtime-setup adaptation afterward. Its test run exposes unresolved react-router-dom imports and missing TextEncoder support, and the final targeted verifier still fails five suites. These concrete unadapted migration surfaces support incomplete-migration over a timeout-only diagnosis; replacing every import exactly as in the reference is not assumed to be the sole valid solution.
